app_blueprint.name: Garden Cheat Codes
app_blueprint.vision: To bridge the gap between traditional gardening wisdom and modern horticultural science, empowering gardeners to achieve guaranteed harvests.
principles: Actionable over Theoretical: Every piece of advice must be a 'cheat code' that can be applied immediately.
Data-Backed Ancestral Wisdom: Combine intuition-based knowledge with scientific validation.
Community-Driven: Foster a space for gardeners to share results and refine codes.
Transparency: Clearly distinguish between anecdotal wisdom and scientific study outcomes.
goals: Reduce gardening failure rates by 50% for users.
Build a community-verified database of 500+ vegetable-specific cheat codes.
Create a sustainable freemium business model.

gatekeeping.free_tier: Access to a limited set of 'Tomato Cheat Codes' (e.g., top 8) to demonstrate value and build trust.
gatekeeping.premium_tier: The 'Vault' membership. Unlocks 500+ codes for all vegetables, advanced lab notes, and community features.

landing_page_structure_hormozi_style.hook: Stop Guessing. Start Growing. Unlock the Secret Cheat Codes to a Legendary Harvest.
pain_points: Wasting time and money on seeds that don't produce.
Conflicting advice from forums that leads to dead plants.
The frustration of 'doing everything right' and still failing.
landing_page_structure_hormozi_style.solution: A curated, data-backed database of 'Cheat Codes' that guarantee results by combining ancestral intuition with PhD-level science.

authority.persona_a: Grandma Beatrice (80 years of ancestral wisdom).
authority.proof: Real-world results from thousands of gardeners.

offer.value: Get the Free Tomato Cheat Sheet immediately.
offer.upsell: Upgrade to the Vault for 500+ proven codes and exclusive lab access.

landing_page_structure_hormozi_style.urgency: The garden doesn't wait. Start applying these codes today to save this season's harvest.
